error[L0315]: this argument is passed `inout`, so the call may change its storage while `first` still views it

16 |     n := count_of(c)
   |                   ^

15 |     first := addr c.items[0]
   |     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ the live derived view
  = note: [0800]/[0830]: the `inout` parameter `self` locks its argument whether or not the routine writes it; finish with `first` before the call and take it again after, or, if the routine only reads it, declare `self` without `inout`
